text: Path.write_text(data, encoding=None, errors=None, newline=None) writes text to a file and closes it. Set encoding="utf-8" to select UTF-8. An existing file is overwritten. The method returns the number of characters written.
Path.read_text(encoding=None, errors=None) opens a file, returns its text as a string and closes the file. Set encoding="utf-8" when reading a UTF-8 file.
json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=True) returns a JSON string. Setting ensure_ascii=False leaves non-ASCII characters in that string. It does not write a file or select the encoding used by a file writer.
In Python 3.13, Path.read_text accepts encoding, errors and newline. The newline parameter was added in Python 3.13. The method returns decoded file text and closes the file.
